gloss: final push; last spurt; home stretch

definitions.gloss: final push; last spurt; home stretch
definitions.explanation: The concentrated effort made in the closing stage of a task, a race, or a period of study, when the deadline or finish line is close.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}の{追|お}い{込|こ}みだ。
{試験|しけん}{前|まえ}の{追|お}い{込|こ}みで{毎日|まいにち}{寝不足|ねぶそく}だ。
examples.english: With the final push before the exam, I am short of sleep every day.

examples.japanese: {納期|のうき}が{近|ちか}いので、{今週|こんしゅう}から{追|お}い{込|こ}みをかけることになった。
examples.english: Since the deadline is near, we have decided to make a final push starting this week.

notes:
The noun form of {追|お}い{込|こ}む (to drive into, to corner). In this use the sense is not "cornering someone" but rather driving a task toward the finish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最後|さいご}の{追|お}い{込|こ}み: the final push
- {追|お}い{込|こ}みをかける: to put on a final push
- {追|お}い{込|こ}み{時期|じき}: crunch period
- {追|お}い{込|こ}みに{入|はい}る: to enter the home stretch

USAGE:
It is used most often of exam study, work deadlines, and the closing laps of a race. In racing it also names a running style in which a horse or runner holds back and overtakes at the end.
